data.title: Advanced Systems Automation Shareholders Approve AGM Resolutions and Board Changes
data.description:

The company’s audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 were adopted, directors’ fees of S$176,000 for the same period were approved, and authority to allot and issue shares under Singapore’s Companies Act and the Catalist Rules was granted.

data.title: Borsa Istanbul Activates Circuit Breaker in OTTO.E Shares
data.description:
OTTO HOLDING A.S ( (TR:OTTO) ) has issued an announcement.

Borsa Istanbul has halted continuous trading in OTTO.E shares and shifted the stock to a single-price call auction order collection process. This move activates the exchange’s equity-based circuit breaker mechanism in response to market conditions affecting the company’s shares.

Under the circuit breaker, order collection for OTTO.E will be merged with the closing auction phase, and all matching will occur during the closing auction session. The measure aims to stabilize trading in the stock and ensure more orderly price formation for investors and other market participants.
